prompt: Generate the Elementor landing page for an isolated copy of the existing test-course.

assertions.name: original-untouched
assertions.text: the original output/test-course/ directory was not modified

assertions.name: exclusive-outcome
assertions.text: exactly one of landing-page.json or REFERENCE_REQUIRED.md was produced

assertions.name: fresh-tier-judgment
assertions.text: the tier decision was made fresh rather than blindly copying test-course's prior REFERENCE_REQUIRED.md verdict

assertions.name: validator-actually-run
assertions.text: validate_elementor_json.py was actually run with a real, quoted pass/fail result

assertions.name: no-banned-widgets
assertions.text: no html/shortcode widgets and no <style>/<script> tags in settings

assertions.name: correct-palette
assertions.text: hardcoded colors are from the live theme tokens, not the retired #3D73FF blue
